name: Outabout
tagline: Seven days out in Tallowmere, every week.
descriptor: A what's-on guide for Tallowmere, an invented city: a weekly list of things to do, event listings and the odd job post. A fictional brand for testing.

money.local: Outabout lists prices in pounds (£) only

voice: Warm, quick and local, like a friend who always knows what is on. Short lines, plain words, a little playful. Say when and where, never oversell, and never invent a venue, a price or a name.
visualDirection: Loud and sunny: a bright orange field, huge black condensed capitals, round pictures in a row, full photos for events with a black title block and a two-colour info footer.

looks.name: Guide
looks.description: A city what's-on guide: a bright field in the brand colour, huge tight condensed capitals with a pill or an icon, a row of round pictures and a round arrow, the week as a label top right; event posters on full photos with a black title block and a two-colour info footer.

compositions.name: Week cover
compositions.describe: The weekly cover: a huge stack of black capitals on the brand field (one or two words may sit in a pill), a row of overlapping round pictures at the foot, a short line and a round arrow. For a short headline of up to 30 characters.

compositions.name: Sticker line
compositions.describe: A big line of black capitals on the brand field with an icon set into it as a sticker (write {{bowl}} or another icon), a short line under it, a row of round pictures and the web address at the foot. For a headline of up to 44 characters.

compositions.name: Big count
compositions.describe: One figure as large as the width allows in black on the brand field, what it counts in condensed capitals under it and a short line in small capitals. For a count such as "10 plans" (up to 6 characters).

compositions.name: Plans list
compositions.describe: A condensed headline on the brand field and the plans as rows on black hairlines, each with a black round number. For two to five short plans.

compositions.name: Overheard
compositions.describe: Something overheard, in big light capitals on the dark page under a brand-colour quotation mark, with the source in brand-colour small capitals. For a line of up to 120 characters.

compositions.name: Talk of the week
compositions.describe: A full photograph darkened at the foot, the headline in light condensed capitals over it (a word may sit in a brand-colour pill), a short line and an arrow; the week in a brand-colour chip top right. For a headline of up to 60 characters.

compositions.name: Now hiring
compositions.describe: A darkened photograph with the headline in light condensed capitals, a word or two of it (written [[like this]]) on a brand-colour block, the roles or details as labelled rows and an apply button in the brand colour. For a job post: a headline of up to 36 characters and one to three info rows.

compositions.name: Poster
compositions.describe: An event poster: the photograph full page, the kind of event in small capitals, the title in light condensed capitals on a black block, a short line and a two-colour footer (When and Where on the light paper, the booking button in the brand colour). For a title of up to 24 characters.

compositions.name: Listing
compositions.describe: A listing on the brand field: the photograph in a rounded window at the top, the title in black condensed capitals, the date and place in small capitals and the details as labelled rows, with a round arrow. For a title of up to 36 characters.

compositions.name: Tickets
compositions.describe: Tickets on the brand field: the headline in black condensed capitals, the photograph as a rounded card, the price in a turned black sticker over its corner, a short line and a booking button. For a headline of up to 36 characters and a price of up to 8.
